title: gleon workspace configuration (.gleon/gleon.yaml)
description: The root configuration structure for gleon.

artifacts.description:
Directory of the images of failed cases (golden, candidate, diff) relative to the workspace
root: `.gleon/runs/latest/artifacts` (the default) or a directory under `.gleon/runs/`
outside `latest/`; `GLEON_ARTIFACTS_DIR` overrides it.

exclude.description: Globs of paths to exclude from testing.

fallback_platform.description:
Optional fallback platform identifier used when current platform baselines are missing.

For integrations that commit goldens as image files (the Flutter package) it is the
platform of the shared goldens (`<dir>/<file>`); only its OS and architecture count, under
the names a process reports (`macos-aarch64`, not `macos-arm64`: others are an error for
integrations). On it text is compared by default; any other platform keeps its own goldens
in `<dir>/<os>-<arch>/<file>` and, until it has one, compares the shared golden with text
ignored by default (see `text_tolerance`). Without it every platform compares the shared
goldens that way. `platform` and the `GLEON_*PLATFORM` variables are read by the CLI only.

metrics.description: Per-golden comparison metrics recorded by integrations such as the Flutter package.

platform.description:
The platform the CLI runs as (e.g. `macos-aarch64`, or `{renderer: impeller}` over the
detected OS and architecture); its flags and `GLEON_PLATFORM` override it.

Read by the CLI only: an integration (the Flutter package) runs as its process's OS and
architecture, the name of the directory of that platform's own goldens.

required_version.description:
The required version range of the CLI to run this configuration.

Enforced by the CLI only; other readers (the Flutter package) just check its syntax.

ArtifactsDir.description: `.gleon/runs/latest/artifacts` or a directory under `.gleon/runs/` outside `latest/`: `/`-separated names of ASCII letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, without `.` or `..`.

DiffConfig.description: Configuration parameters for the diff engine.

color_tolerance.description: Tolerated deviation in 8-bit channel units beyond the local 3x3 envelope (SSIM mode).

min_similarity.description: Minimum local SSIM [0.0, 1.0] every neighborhood must reach (SSIM mode).

Dimension.description: A pixel count, or a percentage of the image size such as "25%".

GlobPattern.description: Case-insensitive glob relative to the workspace root; `*` stays within a path segment, `**` crosses segments.

MaskRule.description: A mask rule specifying which regions of an image to ignore.

path.description: Image path pattern this mask applies to.

zones.description: List of bounding zones to ignore.

MetricsConfig.description:
The `metrics:` section: opt-in per-golden comparison metrics.

The `GLEON_METRICS` environment variable (`1`/`true` or `0`/`false`) overrides `enabled`.

console.description: Print one summary line per golden while metrics are enabled.

enabled.description: Record a JSON case report per golden under `.gleon/runs/latest/cases/`.

Mode.description: Comparison mode for visual regression testing.

OneOrMany.description: JSON Schema shape of a field serialized through this module.

PlatformConfig.description:
A platform: an opaque key, or structured fields.

Its key names its directories (manifests, case reports, failure images): `<os>-<arch>`
(`macos-aarch64`), or `os=<os>+arch=<arch>` when the OS or architecture contains `-`
(`os=ios-sim+arch=arm`), or `<os>` without an architecture; then `+<renderer>`, then
`+<key>=<value>` per label, sorted by key; all lowercase. An opaque value is its own key, so
`macos-aarch64` names the same platform as `{os: macos, arch: aarch64}`.

PlatformFields.description: A parsed representation of structured platform fields.

ScreenshotRule.description: A rule specifying how to match and process screenshots.

include.description: Glob patterns representing the files to include.

masks.description: Optional zones to mask out (ignore) during verification.

text_tolerance.description:
How much text may differ, in `pixel` mode: the largest share of differing pixels in any
tile of the text an integration reports, `[0, 1]`. Unset, it depends on the golden
([`crate::tolerance::TextTolerance::resolve`]): 0.05 against a golden of the platform the
test runs on (see `fallback_platform`), else 1, so text never fails. A value set here
applies to every golden of the rule: 1 turns text comparison off.

TextTolerance.description:
How much text may differ, in pixel and exact mode.

The largest share (`[0, 1]`) of differing pixels in any [`gleon_engine::pixel::TEXT_TILE`]-pixel
tile of the text regions an integration reports (lines of its render tree); everything else
is compared strictly.

Operating systems draw glyphs differently (their font engines, hinting): across them 40% or
more of a tile of text differs while a changed digit of the same width is about a quarter, so
no share tells them apart. [`Self::DEFAULT`] (1) lets text never fail, which is the same verdict as masking
it: layout stays exact, text content is not compared. Lower values compare text, at the
risk of failing on another OS's rendering. Against a golden of the platform it runs on, the
default is [`Self::OWN_PLATFORM`] instead (see [`Self::resolve`]).

x.description: The X coordinate of the top-left corner.

y.description: The Y coordinate of the top-left corner.
